newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ZKB disappointed by UBS 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: ZKB disappointed by UBS 1996 results.

text.p: Zurich Cantonal Bank (ZKB) said it was disappointed by Union Bank of Switzerland's 1996 results, which it saw on balance slightly negative for its share proce.

"UBS's 1996 results were below our expectations," it said in its daily market opinion bulletin. "The operating profit at 4.483 billion francs was slightly negative due to weak trading revenue and higher personnel costs," it said.
"But the expected group loss was better on the basis of diverse disinvestments. On balance the rather weak operating business is slightly negative for the share price."
